criteria.text: The /dashboard route renders the Dashboard page contract inside the selected Rhythm shell.
criteria.test_id: issue-2001-c1: dashboard route renders the real page contract in the selected shell

criteria.text: Focus-for-this-week, today/week/project progress, planning lists, and unread preview match deterministic fixture data and the reference composition.
criteria.test_id: issue-2001-c2: ready composition and fixture values cover focus planning unread and empties

criteria.text: Refresh visibly moves loading to ready or error, Retry recovers without reload, and the complete URL-driven state matrix is deterministic.
criteria.test_id: issue-2001-c3: refresh and deterministic state matrix recover without reload

criteria.text: Every enabled Dashboard control has an observable outcome, and Dashboard dialogs support Escape and focus restoration.
criteria.test_id: issue-2001-c4: every enabled Dashboard control has an outcome and dialogs restore focus

criteria.text: Adding a task validates title, applies schedule and collaborator selections, inserts the task, updates counts, and emits exact POST receipts.
criteria.test_id: issue-2001-c5: add task validates and applies scheduling and collaborator selections

criteria.text: Completing a task updates the correct row and summary through the exact PATCH task receipt.
criteria.test_id: issue-2001-c6: task completion updates the row and summary with the exact PATCH receipt

criteria.text: Completing a project step updates only its project row and progress summary through the exact project-step PATCH receipt.
criteria.test_id: issue-2001-c7: project-step completion updates only its project and summary

criteria.text: Planner, Projects, Messages, and unread-thread shortcuts navigate to their exact hash routes.
criteria.test_id: issue-2001-c8: Planner Projects Messages and thread shortcuts use exact routes

criteria.text: Quick Actions select one action at a time and produce an explicit client-side handoff state rather than a toast-only dead end.
criteria.test_id: issue-2001-c9: quick actions expose one explicit client-side handoff at a time

criteria.text: The representative ready Dashboard has zero serious or critical axe accessibility violations.
criteria.test_id: issue-2001-c10: ready Dashboard has no serious or critical axe violations

criteria.text: Dashboard has no page-level horizontal overflow at 1440, 1024, 768, or 390 CSS pixels and survives RTL, 200% text, forced colors, reduced motion, and long CJK/emoji fixture content.
criteria.test_id: issue-2001-c11: Dashboard is responsive under narrow and edge-case presentation modes

criteria.text: Dashboard fixtures are deterministic across reload and never contact non-loopback or production services.
criteria.test_id: issue-2001-c12: fixture data is reload-stable and network-isolated
